The '''Ruur Killik Hivewoods''' was a region in the southern end of [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was named after the [[Ruur]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nest, which during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] emerged from hibernation and established large hives throughout the area. [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] [[Wardpost Luurdes]] was located at the southern edge of the area, and its personnel worked to prevent the Killiks from spreading to the [[Alsakan Lowlands]].
